name: spendiq-ai
description: SpendIQ AI — Smart Personal Finance Manager (React + Express + MongoDB)

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.start:prod: npm run build && SERVE_CLIENT=true NODE_ENV=production npm --prefix server start
scripts.test: npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix client test
